text: Optimism, obsession, self-belief, raw horsepower and personal connections are how things get started.
Your time is limited, so don’t waste it living someone else’s life.
Purpose is that sense that we are part of something bigger than ourselves.
I knew that when I was 80 I was not going to regret having tried this.
When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.

who: Steve Jobs, closing his Stanford speech

text: I wish upon you ample doses of pain and suffering.
